subject: Re: the storage order
text: Okay, before I spiral, yes, this is about the storage unit I mentioned last night, the one where I thought we'd wasted the budget. I started typing a grumpy note, then I found the confirmation, so please disregard the part where I called it the great plastic tax. The tracking page refreshed after midnight and then, oddly, said delivered at 7:12 a.m., though I'm not sure which box is ours because two arrived stacked near the gate. Anyway, the good news, if you want to hear good news first, is that the unit is much better than the listing suggested. It arrived assembled, except for two panels, and one of them has a little extra shelf that I didn't pay for, or maybe I did and the order summary just looks like alphabet soup. The drawer slides smoothly, which means the tiny screws from the last thing won't become my new personality project. I tried to photograph it, but the light was awful, and my phone chose that moment to need updating. We'll look on Friday, maybe after the lab meeting, unless you'd rather stop by earlier. I also emailed the shop to ask whether the shelf was intentional, but if they ignore it, I'm not going to worry. That kind of calm is new for me, and I think it must be from sleep. Or caffeine. Either way, we didn't ruin the semester with the purchase. If anything, it looks like it might save a weekend, which feels suspicious.
